scenes.heading: Refresh your case studies every quarter

sents.d: Refresh your case studies every quarter
Old examples undersell what you can do now. Refresh them every three months.
A story from two years ago shows a version of you with less experience.
Prospects compare that to the price you charge today.
Pick your two strongest recent results and write each as a short before and after.
Get written permission, then replace the oldest examples on your website.

take: Two fresh before-and-after stories, every three months.
